thread:
Ivy: Quick micro-shout: Rafael and Mira saved our partner demo tonight by spotting a bad config rollout. literally patched and redeployed in 12 mins. heroes. :sparkles: :raised_hands:
Rafael: wild how one env var did this. spotted the stray FEATURE_FLAG=true in the canary. rolled it back.
Mira: yup, odd default sneaked in during the last deploy. reverted and validated traffic. glad the partner call stayed calm.
TJ: huge thanks from the partnerships side — the client asked for follow-up docs on what happened. Rafael/Mira, could you ping a 1-paragraph summary? :memo:
Rafael: sending a short blurb now and will add to the incident notes.
Mira: i'll add the config diff and the guard rule to infra/ops-runbook too. snippet: `# guard: ensure FEATURE_FLAG unset in prod; CI assert`
Ivy: folks, i put you up on the kudos board and nominated you for a spot on the monthly "mic-drop" list. coffee voucher incoming. :coffee:
people-ops: Coffee vouchers issued to Rafael and Mira. Recognition badge added. :tada:
Rafael: thanks everyone. special shout to TJ for keeping the client calm during the quick rollback.
TJ: doing my best customer soothing voice. :smile: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/relief-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI
ops-bot: Created follow-up ticket "doc-config-guard-for-feature-flag" assigned to Mira, due in 4 days. (https://tracker.redwood/issue/9999)
Ivy: ending thread with many thanks. Team vibes are strong tonight. :heart:
